title.en: Chapter 11 — What I Heard in the Apple Barrel

sentences.en: It was Silver's voice.
But not the voice I knew.
A cold voice, without laughter.

sentences.ar: كان بيحكي مع بحار شاب، اسمه دك.
sentences.en: He was talking with a young sailor, named Dick.

sentences.ar: قال سيلفر: أنا كنت مع فلينت.
sentences.en: Silver said: I was with Flint.
I was his powder man.

sentences.ar: والأعمى بيو كان معنا، وبيلي بونز.
sentences.en: And blind Pew was with us, and Billy Bones.

sentences.ar: كلهم ماتوا فقرا، وأنا معي مصاري بالبنك.
sentences.en: They all died poor, and I have money in the bank.
Because I am clever.
Dick said: and me?
What becomes of me?
Silver said: you are with us.
Gentlemen of fortune, that is what we call ourselves.

sentences.ar: ولما نوصل عالجزيرة، ونطلع الكنز، كل واحد بياخد حصته.
sentences.en: And when we reach the island, and dig up the treasure, everyone takes his share.
Dick said: and the captain?
And the squire?
And the doctor?
Silver said: let them get us there.
We need them to sail the ship.

sentences.ar: وبعدين، لما يصير الكنز عالسفينة، بنشوف.
sentences.en: And then, when the treasure is on the ship, we will see.
Dick said: you mean we kill them?
Silver said: dead men do not bite.

sentences.ar: كنت جوا البرميل، وما بتنفس، وقلبي بيدق زي طبل.
sentences.en: I was inside the barrel, not breathing, my heart beating like a drum.
This was the man I had loved.

sentences.ar: هاد اللي كان يقول إني بشبهه.
sentences.en: The one who said I was like him.

sentences.ar: وإجا واحد تالت، إسرائيل هاندز، الملاح.
sentences.en: And a third came, Israel Hands, the coxswain.

sentences.ar: قال هاندز: يا جون، لحد إيمتى بدنا نستنى؟
sentences.en: Hands said: John, how long do we wait?
I am sick of the captain.

sentences.ar: قال سيلفر: لحد ما أقول أنا.
sentences.en: Silver said: until I say.
The last moment possible.
Hands said: and the boy?
Jim?
Silver said: I like the boy.

sentences.ar: بس لما ييجي وقته، بياخد حصته زي الباقي.
sentences.en: But when his time comes, he takes his share like the rest.

sentences.ar: قال سيلفر: يلا يا دك، جيب لي تفاحة من البرميل.
sentences.en: Silver said: come on, Dick, get me an apple from the barrel.
And I said: it is over, I am finished.
But Hands said: apples?
Let us drink rum.

sentences.ar: وراح دك يجيب الرم، وقعدوا يشربوا.
sentences.en: And Dick went to fetch rum, and they sat drinking.

sentences.ar: وبنفس اللحظة، صرخ واحد من فوق: أرض!
sentences.en: And in that same moment, someone shouted from above: land!
Land!

sentences.ar: وركض الكل عالمقدمة، وأنا طلعت من البرميل واختلطت فيهم.
sentences.en: And everyone ran to the bow, and I climbed out of the barrel and mixed in among them.
And I saw the island, for the first time, in the moonlight.
Three hills, and mist, and black trees.
